contentEn:
Metro Vancouver commercial renovation costs in 2026 range from $80 to $700 per square foot depending on the type of space. An office refresh costs $80–$160/sq ft; a retail build-out runs $100–$300/sq ft; a restaurant with a full commercial kitchen costs $200–$500/sq ft; and a medical clinic runs $300–$700/sq ft. Reno Stars has delivered all four types of projects in Burnaby and Vancouver — this guide uses real cost data from those completed projects.

What Does a Commercial Renovation Cost in Vancouver? Table of 2026 Rates

Commercial renovation costs in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver are quoted per square foot of the affected area. The table below reflects 2026 market rates including materials, labour, permits, and BC Building Code compliance. Prices vary based on scope, building class, and the complexity of the space.

Office Renovation Cost in Vancouver: Tenant Improvements

An office renovation in Vancouver covers anything from a cosmetic refresh of an existing space to a full tenant improvement (TI) build-out. Tenant improvements are the work a landlord or tenant does to customize a space — flooring, ceilings, partitions, electrical, and data runs.

A standard office refresh for a Vancouver or Burnaby office space (1,000–2,500 sq ft) runs $80,000–$200,000 in 2026. A mid-range refresh covers new carpet tile or LVP flooring, fresh paint, suspended ceiling replacement, LED lighting upgrades, and partition reconfiguration. Off-hours scheduling (evenings and weekends) adds roughly 10–15% to labour costs but keeps the business operating.

Reno Stars completed a full floor refresh for a Burnaby dental office — new flooring, fresh paint, updated reception area millwork, and LED retrofits — at a total investment of $92,000 for a 1,800 sq ft space. See the dental clinic renovation project.

For offices in strata buildings, expect freight elevator booking fees, after-hours work restrictions, and building protection requirements — these add roughly $8,000–$20,000 to a project budget that would otherwise be $150,000–$250,000 for a 2,000 sq ft open-plan refresh.

Retail Renovation Cost: Store Build-Outs in Vancouver and Burnaby

A retail build-out in Metro Vancouver ranges from $100 to $300 per square foot. A 1,500 sq ft retail space in Burnaby or Metrotown costs approximately $150,000–$450,000 to fully build out. That covers the base build (shell, mechanical, electrical, fire separation) plus finishes, fixtures, and any specialty requirements such as refrigerated cases or security systems.

Reno Stars recently completed a toy store renovation in Metrotown, Burnaby — a full interior refresh including new display shelving, updated flooring, fresh paint, and improved lighting. See the toy store renovation project. The project delivered a retail-ready space that opened on schedule and within budget.

Key cost drivers for Vancouver and Burnaby retail build-outs include: structural changes to open up a storefront, adding a mezzanine for additional selling area, and compliance with BC Plumbing Code for any food or beverage component. Each of these adds $15,000–$60,000 to a base budget.

Restaurant Renovation Cost in Vancouver

Restaurant renovation in Vancouver is the most complex and expensive category in commercial work. A full commercial kitchen build-out alone — including Type I exhaust hood, fire suppression, grease trap, walk-in cooler, and health-authority-compliant prep area — costs $80,000–$230,000 in 2026, before the dining area is even priced.

When the dining area is included, a 2,000 sq ft restaurant renovation in Vancouver or Burnaby runs $400,000–$900,000. A smaller 800–1,200 sq ft café or quick-service restaurant renovation costs $200,000–$450,000.

Critical items in a Vancouver restaurant renovation budget:

  • Commercial vent hood (Type I, installed): $35,000–$90,000
  • Make-up air unit: $15,000–$35,000
  • Grease trap (1,000 lb interior): $8,000–$18,000
  • Walk-in cooler (8×10): $25,000–$45,000
  • Health Authority sign-off coordination: $5,000–$15,000
  • Liquor licence fit-out (if applicable): $5,000–$15,000

Off-hours construction is common for Vancouver restaurants — a requirement that adds 10–20% to labour costs but allows a restaurant to remain open during the renovation. Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Medical and Dental Clinic Renovation Cost

Medical and dental clinic renovations in Vancouver and Burnaby command the highest per-square-foot costs in commercial work — $300 to $700/sq ft in 2026. The premium reflects clinical-grade mechanical, electrical, and finishes requirements, plus regulatory compliance with Vancouver Coastal Health and the BC College of Dental Surgeons.

A 2,000 sq ft dental clinic renovation in Burnaby — with four operatories, a sterilization room, reception, and barrier-free washroom — ran $680,000 all-in in 2025. That project included lead-lined X-ray rooms ($35,000), HEPA-grade HVAC upgrades ($42,000), and CSA B651 barrier-free washroom construction ($38,000). See the full dental clinic renovation project.

A 1,200 sq ft skin lab and wellness clinic in Vancouver — with treatment rooms, reception, and retail display — was completed at $310,000. See the skin lab renovation project.

What Drives a Vancouver Commercial Renovation Cost Up

Five factors most commonly push a Metro Vancouver commercial renovation budget beyond the initial estimate:

  • Strata building restrictions — after-hours-only work in high-rise office and retail centres adds 10–20% to labour costs and extends timelines by 20–40%.
  • BC Building Code Part 3 compliance — buildings over three storeys or 600 sq m fall under Part 3, which requires architect and engineer involvement, sprinkler system upgrades, and detailed fire safety plans. This adds $15,000–$50,000 in design and permit fees before a single piece of drywall is hung.
  • Change of use — converting an office to a restaurant or salon triggers a change of use that can require full mechanical and sprinkler system upgrades. Budget $25,000–$80,000 for this alone.
  • Asbestos abatement — pre-1990 commercial buildings in Vancouver and Burnaby frequently contain asbestos in floor tile, pipe insulation, or spray-on fireproofing. Asbestos remediation runs $10,000–$80,000 depending on the building size and extent of contamination.
  • Heritage building requirements — buildings in Vancouver Heritage Conservation Areas (such as Gastown, Strathcona, or the West End) may require heritage alteration permits and review, adding $10,000–$30,000 and 4–8 weeks to a project timeline.

Timeline for Commercial Renovations in Vancouver and Burnaby

How long a commercial renovation takes depends on the complexity of the space and the permitting path. A straightforward office refresh (no structural changes, no change of use) can be completed in 4–10 weeks. A retail build-out takes 8–14 weeks. A restaurant with a full commercial kitchen runs 14–24 weeks. A medical clinic — with health authority sign-off, clinical HVAC, and lead-lined rooms — takes 16–28 weeks.

Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule before construction begins. All commercial projects include a written scope, fixed-price contract, BC permit package, $5M CGL insurance, WorkSafeBC coverage, and a 2-year workmanship warranty.

Frequently Asked Questions — Commercial Renovation Cost Vancouver

How much does a commercial renovation cost per square foot in Vancouver in 2026?

A commercial renovation in Vancouver costs $80 to $700 per square foot in 2026 depending on the type of space. Office refreshes run $80–$160/sq ft. Retail build-outs run $100–$300/sq ft. Restaurants with commercial kitchens run $200–$500/sq ft. Medical and dental clinics run $300–$700/sq ft. These rates include materials, labour, permits, and BC Building Code compliance for Metro Vancouver projects.

Do I need a permit for a commercial renovation in Vancouver?

Yes — a BC building permit is required for any commercial renovation in Vancouver, Burnaby, or Metro Vancouver that involves structural changes, plumbing work, electrical upgrades, changes to fire suppression systems, changes of use, or any work that affects means of egress. Reno Stars handles all permit applications and coordinates required inspections as part of every commercial project.

How long does a commercial renovation take in Vancouver?

An office refresh takes 4–10 weeks. A retail build-out takes 8–14 weeks. A restaurant renovation with a commercial kitchen takes 14–24 weeks. A medical or dental clinic renovation takes 16–28 weeks. Heritage buildings and strata buildings add 4–8 weeks to these timelines due to permit and scheduling requirements.

What is included in a Vancouver commercial renovation contract?

A complete commercial renovation contract with Reno Stars includes: written scope of work, fixed-price contract, BC Building Permit package, BC Building Code compliance verification, $5M Commercial General Liability insurance, WorkSafeBC coverage, and a 2-year workmanship warranty. All commercial projects also include a pre-construction survey, lease review where applicable, and a detailed project schedule before construction begins.

温哥华办公室装修费用：租户改善工程

温哥华的办公室装修涵盖从现有空间的美化翻新到完整的租户改善（TI）装修工程。租户改善工程是房东或租户为定制空间所做的工程——地板、天花板、隔断、电气和数据布线。

温哥华或Burnaby标准办公室翻新（1,000至2,500平方英尺）在2026年的费用为$80,000至$200,000。中档翻新包括新地毯砖或LVP地板、新油漆、更换吊顶、新LED照明和隔断重新配置。夜间和周末施工会增加约10%至15%的人工成本，但可保持业务正常运营。

Reno Stars为一家Burnaby牙科诊所完成了整层翻新工程——新地板、新油漆、更新接待区木制品和LED照明改造——总面积1,800平方英尺，总费用为$92,000。查看牙科诊所翻新项目。

对于分契式建筑中的办公室，需支付货运电梯预订费、加班工作限制和建筑保护要求——这些额外增加约$8,000至$20,000的预算，而2,000平方英尺开放平面翻新的原本预算为$150,000至$250,000。

零售店铺装修费用：温哥华和Burnaby门店装修

Metro Vancouver零售店铺装修费用为每平方英尺$100至$300。Burnaby或Metrotown 1,500平方英尺零售空间的全套装修费用约为$150,000至$450,000。这包括基础建筑（毛坯、机电、消防分隔）以及装修、固件和任何特殊要求（如冷藏展示柜或安保系统）。

Reno Stars最近在Burnaby Metrotown完成了一家玩具店的翻新工程——包括新展示架、地板翻新、油漆更新和照明改善。查看玩具店翻新项目。该项目按计划交付，餐厅装修费用在预算范围内。

温哥华和Burnaby零售店铺装修的主要成本驱动因素包括：打开店面的结构变更、为增加销售区域添加夹层，以及为任何食品或饮料组件符合BC管道规范。这些项目各增加$15,000至$60,000的基础预算。

温哥华餐厅装修费用

温哥华餐厅装修是商业工作中最复杂、成本最高的类别。仅商业厨房的建设——包括一级排风罩、消防系统、油脂分离器、冷藏室和符合卫生当局要求的备餐区——在2026年的费用就为$80,000至$230,000，这还不包括餐饮区的费用。

加上餐饮区，温哥华或Burnaby 2,000平方英尺餐厅的装修费用为$400,000至$900,000。较小的800至1,200平方英尺咖啡馆或快餐店装修费用为$200,000至$450,000。

温哥华餐厅装修预算中的关键项目：

  • 商业排油烟机（一级，已安装）：$35,000至$90,000
  • 补风机：$15,000至$35,000
  • 油脂分离器（1,000磅室内型）：$8,000至$18,000
  • 步入式冷藏室（8×10）：$25,000至$45,000
  • 卫生部门签字协调：$5,000至$15,000
  • 酒类许可证装修（如适用）：$5,000至$15,000

餐厅的夜间施工是温哥华的常见要求——这一要求使人工成本增加10%至20%，但允许餐厅在装修期间继续营业。计划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？获取Reno Stars的免费、无义务报价。

医疗和牙科诊所装修费用

温哥华和Burnaby医疗和牙科诊所装修在商业工作中每平方英尺收费最高——2026年为每平方英尺$300至$700。溢价反映了临床级别的机械、电气和饰面要求，以及对温哥华沿海卫生部和BC省牙科医学院法规的合规要求。

Burnaby一家2,000平方英尺牙科诊所的翻新——包括四个治疗室、消毒室、接待区和无障碍洗手间——2025年全包费用为$680,000。该项目包括X光室铅板（$35,000）、HEPA级暖通空调升级（$42,000）和CSA B651无障碍洗手间建设（$38,000）。查看牙科诊所翻新项目。

温哥华一家1,200平方英尺皮肤工作室和健康诊所——设有治疗室、接待区和零售展示区——完成费用为$310,000。查看皮肤实验室翻新项目。

哪些因素会增加温哥华商业装修费用

以下五个因素最常见地使Metro Vancouver商业装修预算超出初始估算：

  • 分契式建筑限制——高层办公楼和零售中心的仅夜间工作规定使人工成本增加10%至20%，并使时间线延长20%至40%。
  • BC省建筑规范第3部分合规——超过三层或600平方米的建筑物适用第3部分，需要建筑师和工程师参与、消防系统升级和详细的消防安全计划。这在挂第一块石膏板之前就增加了$15,000至$50,000的设计和许可费用。
  • 使用变更——将办公室改为餐厅或美容院会触发使用变更，可能需要对机械和消防系统进行全套升级。仅为这项预留$25,000至$80,000。
  • 石棉 abatement——温哥华和Burnaby 1990年前的商业建筑经常在地砖、管道保温或喷涂防火材料中含有石棉。石棉 remediation费用为$10,000至$80,000，取决于建筑规模和处理范围。
  • 历史建筑要求——位于温哥华历史保护区的建筑物（如Gastown、Strathcona或西端）可能需要历史变更许可证和审查，为项目时间线增加$10,000至$30,000和4至8周。

温哥华和Burnaby商业装修时间线

商业装修需要多长时间取决于空间的复杂性和许可路径。简单的办公室翻新（无结构变更、无使用变更）可在4至10周内完成。零售店铺装修需要8至14周。带完整商业厨房的餐厅装修需要14至24周。医疗诊所——包括卫生部门签字、临床暖通空调和铅板室——需要16至28周。
